::: {.lyrics}
### Chorus
Wa Emi mimo jowo wa gbe wa wo fun wa l'agbara Emi mimo/fun wa l'agbara emi

### Verse 1
| Emi mimo gbe wa wo gbe wa wo baba/2x ninu orin wa o baba dakun tu ide. ko ja ide  ninu orin wao baba jeka ri anu gba Emi mimo (gbe wawo)2x baba o ati de.

### Verse 2
| Bi na ba wole okunkun aparada Emi orun o wole afe ri o kotu ide koja ide ko wa wo alaisan san niti pentecost ti lojosi lye niyara oke. Emi mimo (gbe wawo) loni o baba.

### Verse 3
| Olorun aye-agbara lawa yi ijoba orun da f'agbarawo alagbara lole gbaa femi Orun be wawo kale d'alagbara ninu re
Hymn: Gbat'agbara Olorun de ...
